description:
The device management intents

TIP: Gets a legacy Endpoint security intent by ID. Pass $expand=settings,assignments,deviceStateSummary to get its configured values (settings[]: definitionId, valueJson), target groups and device counts (successCount, errorCount, conflictCount, notApplicableCount, inGracePeriodCount) in one call. Supports $select and $expand.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure
